blogs.title: GLP-1 Agents and Muscle Injury: IMNM vs Toxic Rhabdo at the Bedside
blogs.description: How to distinguish immune-mediated necrotising myopathy (IMNM) from toxic rhabdomyolysis in patients exposed to GLP-1 receptor agonists. We walk through clinical tempo, CK trajectories, timing relative to drug exposure, biopsy hallmarks, and treatment response. The case contrasts a delayed, progressive, seronegative IMNM requiring immunosuppression after a single semaglutide dose with the classic rapid-onset, rapidly resolving rhabdo pattern reported with tirzepatide.

blogs.title: Seronegative IMNM: Diagnosing the Antibody-Negative Myopathy
blogs.description: A practical diagnostic pathway for seronegative IMNM when myositis panels are negative. Using the case to highlight MRI patterns, biopsy findings (necrosis/regeneration, MAC positivity, CD68 myophagocytosis, paucity of lymphocytes), and the role of excluding CTD, thyroid disease, and drug/toxin mimics. Tips for coordinating neurology/rheumatology, when to pursue EMG/biopsy, and how to avoid mislabeling as deconditioning or toxic myopathy.

blogs.title: Steroids, IVIG, and the Exit Strategy: Managing Severe IMNM Without Lifelong Immunosuppression
blogs.description: A management-focused deep dive: when to pulse methylprednisolone, indications for early IVIG, monitoring CK and function, and planning a rapid taper if drug-induced IMNM is suspected. We discuss infection risk mitigation (the patient’s septic UTI), VTE history considerations, swallow and respiratory assessments, and criteria for stopping therapy once strength and biomarkers normalize.

blogs.title: From Signal to Causality: Applying WHO-UMC to Suspected GLP-1–Triggered Autoimmunity
blogs.description: Using this semaglutide-associated IMNM to illustrate structured causality assessment: temporal association, alternative explanations, dechallenge response, and why rechallenge is unethical. Practical steps for pharmacovigilance in the GLP-1 era—counseling patients, what to monitor (symptoms, CK when indicated), documenting and reporting adverse events, and considerations for avoiding class re-exposure.

blogs.title: AST/ALT in Myopathy and NAFLD: Don’t Let the Liver Take the Fall
blogs.description: A clinician’s guide to parsing transaminase elevations when muscle disease and fatty liver coexist. When do AST/ALT track with CK? How to interpret persistent transaminitis after CK normalizes. Using this case’s serial labs and biopsies to frame a stepwise approach: labs, imaging, correlation with muscle injury, and when a liver biopsy still adds value.

blogs.title: Cardiac Involvement in Inflammatory Myopathies: Reading the Biomarkers and MRI
blogs.description: Approach to elevated hs-troponin and BNP in suspected inflammatory myopathy. Interpreting echo and cardiac MRI findings that straddle early myocarditis versus stress cardiomyopathy, and how to time follow-up imaging. Practical screening pearls, when to involve cardiology, and how cardiac recovery tracks with control of the underlying myopathy.
